_comment: Single source of truth for this repository's Zenodo identifiers.
Until the canonical repository is published to Zenodo, every DOI in the tree is a
placeholder token and this file says so. Fill it with scripts/set_doi.py — do not
hand-edit the DOI strings in README.md / CITATION.cff / CHANGELOG.md, because four
carriers have to stay in step and hand-editing is how they drift apart.
See DOI_PENDING.md for the publication steps.
_version_note: The release version is NOT duplicated here. .zenodo.json owns it, scripts/cut_release.sh
checks it against CITATION.cff and CHANGELOG.md, and a second copy in this file would be
one more place for the three of them to disagree. Read it from .zenodo.json.
note_on_predecessor_doi: The associated manuscript's Data availability statement currently cites 10.5281/zenodo.22910500 / .22910501, which resolve to wu-yijing/eqtl-source-discordance-audit v1.0.0 (2026-09-23) — a 2.34 MB snapshot that predates every gap closure in metadata/ARCHIVE_MAP.md, the committed figure build outputs, and the SI ACAT-O rule. Publishing this repository and citing the resulting DOI is what closes that mismatch.
